The '''Mutated Geonosian hive''' was the main nest of the [[Mutated Geonosian]]s and their [[Mutated Geonosian queen|queen]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]], during the [[third Galactic War]]. As the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] [[Invasion of Ossus|invaded]] the planet, the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Malora]] unleashed her Mutated Geonosian experiments against the [[Jedi Colony]], but the [[Insectoid/Legends|insectoid]] [[Species/Legends|species]] eventually turned rogue and started attacking both Imperials and [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] forces.
